evidence: In both cases, the O/Pr atomic ratio was reported to be higher than the 3:2 ratio expected for Pr2O3 [17, 18]. Adsorption of excessive H2O and the formation of hydroxides during oxygen precursor pulses were introduced as possible reasons for this result, while the partial decomposition of hydroxides and release of H2O during Pr(amd) pulses were suggested as reasons for the additional growth of the film material near the precursor inlet, which increases the thickness non-uniformity in the gas flow direction [18].
